title: Building Life Safety Plans Examiner
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.
Job Overview
We are seeking a Building Life Safety Plans Examiner to join Loss Prevention organization (LP).
LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.
Your primary role is to work with planning, design and construction organizations to ensure buildings and safety systems are constructed according to the International Code Council (ICC) model code regulations as adopted and modified by Saudi Aramco and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
Keu Responsibilities
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Support Saudi Aramco departments and organizations to implement required fire and life safety regulations.
Conduct field inspections of new buildings under construction and existing building conditions.
Provide clear reports to communicate safety concerns and develop practical and cost-effective corrective actions.
Participate in various safety studies/activities, such as fire tests, incident investigations, compliance reviews, or insurance surveys including evaluation of risks and potential consequences.
Develop and/or review corporate safety standards, instructions and procedures related to safe building operations and formalize them into company-documented practices as required.
Review designs for new building construction, additions, alterations or changes of occupancy for compliance with ICC, company and industry safety standards, such as NFPA, ASME, ASTM, ANSI, and UL.
Participate in incident investigations as required and prepare safety improvement recommendations.
Minimum Requirements
You will hold a Bachelor of Science degree in any engineering (or architectural) discipline related to building and fire safety,
You will have and 10 years of relevant plan review and inspection experience, would including areas such as: plan review of building and fire safety, accessibility, mechanical, electrical and fire protection and alarm plans, calculations and specification; required field inspections of rough, final and special construction; and evaluation of materials for compliance to ICC requirements.
You will have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management,
You will also be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.
Working Environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: senai cetiqt
description:
QUEM SOMOS?
A indústria brasileira cria mais do que produtos, ela cria oportunidades e transforma vidas
No SENAI CETIQT nós trabalhamos para transformar vidas desenvolvendo oportunidades e soluções para uma indústria têxtil, química e de confecção mais inovadora, tecnológica e sustentável.
Antes de te apresentar quem somos é muito importante que você conheça o significado do nosso nome:
SENAI significa Serviço Nacional de Aprendizagem Industrial e CETIQT é um Centro de Tecnologia da Indústria Química e Têxtil.
Só pelo significado dos nomes você já consegue entender a relevância e papel estratégico que a nossa instituição desempenha ao apoiar o sistema S (SENAI, SESI, IEL) e capacitar profissionais para as demandas da indústria brasileira.
Porém, nós vamos muito além da capacitação de profissionais por meio de graduações, pós-graduações e cursos de curta duração.
Nós também desenvolvemos tecnologias, oferecemos consultorias em diversas áreas para empresas, microempreendedores e para a Defesa Estratégica do país, como as forças armadas, realizamos testes metrológicos acreditados pelo INMETRO, promovemos estudos de futuro, e personalizamos o ensino técnico para a necessidade das indústrias têxteis, de confecção e química.
Agora vamos entender um pouco mais sobre quem é o SENAI CETIQT?
O SENAI CETIQT é um centro de excelência reconhecido nacionalmente pela sua capacidade de gerar conhecimento e inovação para as cadeias produtivas dos setores químico, têxtil e de confecção.
Com mais de 75 anos de história, a instituição desempenha um papel fundamental no fortalecimento do futuro da indústria química e da moda, formando profissionais altamente capacitados, oferecendo consultorias especializadas e customizadas, e impulsionando o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, processos e projetos de pesquisa.
Alinhado às necessidades da indústria brasileira e às principais tendências globais, o SENAI CETIQT se dedica a promover a inovação, a sustentabilidade e a competitividade da indústria nacional, consolidando-se como um pilar essencial para o crescimento e a transformação do setor.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
1 - Facilitar a participação plena e efetiva do estudante em atividades acadêmicas, práticas e institucionais.
2 - Auxiliar o aluno durante aulas, atividades acadêmicas, avaliações e diferentes espaços acadêmicos.
3 - Ajudar na organização de materiais, rotinas e orientações dadas pelo professor.
4 - Apoiar o uso de recursos de acessibilidade e tecnologias assistivas
5 - Facilitar a interação do estudante com colegas, professores e coordenação pedagógica.
Requisitos e qualificações
É necessário ter concluído 50% da graduação em Pedagogia, Psicologia ou Psicopedagogia e estar entre o 5º período ao 6º período.

title: Instrument Technician
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To


  • Instrument Supervisor

    • Background


  • The Technician is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside items like flanges, bolts and valves.
  • The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The technician/operator will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.

    • Authority


  • The Instrument Technician is authorized to maintain Instrument assets and systems safely.

    • Immediate Subordinates


  • Subcontractors, Visitors, Vendor Representatives

    • Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards


    1) Dismantle and Reassemble Instrumentation Equipment

    1.1 Identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling.

    1.2 Use correct procedures and correct method of dismantling.

    1.3 Carry out the correct isolation and disconnection procedure.

    1.4 Identify, check and prepare components.

    1.5 Apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.

    2) Monitor and Maintain the Condition of Instrumentation Equipment

    2.1 Adjust instruments to meet the operating specification.

    2.2 Adjust with minimum disruption to any ongoing activities and minimum waste of resources.

    2.3 Monitor and record what has been carried out in work history or log.

    3) Diagnose Faults in Equipment.

    3.1 Respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures.

    3.2 Select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures and apply them methodically.

    3.3 Carry out Visual, Close and Detailed inspections on 'Ex' equipment.

    3.4 Use the results of inspections to determine the appropriate actions to take.

    3.5 Record an accurate and full description in the appropriate document history.

    4) Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures.

    4.1 Unplanned discharges to the environment are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.

    4.2 Relevant PPE is used to deal with unplanned discharges using company procedures.

    4.3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.

    4.4 Environmental protection and pollution control are enforced effectively with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.

    5) Emergency Response

    5.1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).

    5.2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

    Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies


    Offshore - Demonstrate an Understanding of PandIds Offshore - Handover Offshore - Diagnosis and Fault Finding Offshore - Reports Offshore - Computerised Maintenance Management System Offshore - Planning Work Offshore - Dismantling, Repair and Reassemble Equipment Offshore - Hazardous Area Classification Offshore - Safety Management

    Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience


  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Instrument Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Experience desired with offshore experience preferred.
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Instrument/Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • COMP ex E'X' course preferred.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox's top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 160 million monthly active players across our games, we are the #1 Roblox developer by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 85+ full-time remote team members across the globe.
Our strategy is to acquire and sustainably grow games on Roblox. Our acquisition strategy is backed with significant capital from firms including The Raine Group, Makers Fund, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), QIA, Dune Ventures, and MIT.
Our top games include:
Brookhaven, #1 Roleplay game on Roblox and the most popular game on the Roblox platform
Driving Empire, the #1 driving game on Roblox where we've brought real cars into the game in partnership with automakers
NFL Universe Football, the #1 American football game and top grossing sports game on Roblox.
Role Overview
Driving Empire is one of the largest and fastest-growing games on Roblox. We're looking for a Marketing Specialist (Growth) to help grow the game through creative experimentation, fast execution, and platform-native thinking.
This is a hands-on role for someone who loves Roblox, enjoys testing ideas, and is excited to ship content quickly.
You will drive Driving Empire's attention inside Roblox (thumbnails, icons, page optimization) and outside Roblox (social + community content), working closely with Product, Art, and Community
What You'll Do
Roblox Page & Asset Optimization (Primary Focus)
Come up with ideas for thumbnails, icons, and Roblox page visuals
Work with our artists to brief and refine visual concepts (you won't be creating 3D renders yourself)
Publish and test assets directly on Roblox
Review performance dashboards and identify what's working (and what isn't)
Recommend and execute the next round of experiments based on results
Social & Community Content
Help ideate and execute content for platforms like Twitter/X, Discord, Instagram, TikTok
Capture Roblox gameplay footage and create simple, engaging videos
Support community engagement initiatives tied to in-game moments or updates
Bring inspiration from other Roblox games and creator communities
Projects & Growth Experiments
Support creator or YouTuber experiments
Contribute to new ideas that drive player growth or engagement
Help move ad-hoc projects forward when there's an opportunity to test something new
Who You Are
Strong familiarity with Roblox (as a player, creator, or community member)
Experience creating or running content for social platforms (personal or professional)
Proof that you've taken ideas from concept → execution → publish
Comfort capturing gameplay and doing light video/image editing
Ability to read dashboards, basic Google Sheets and explain what's happening at a practical level
Good time management and ability to prioritize your own tasks
Comfortable sharing ideas, collaborating, and learning from others
You don't need years of professional experience - personal projects, side projects, or creator work absolutely count
Nice to Have
Experience working on or around Roblox games
Exposure to SEO, social optimization, or content performance testing
Spanish language skills
Experience in gaming, UGC, or creator-led communities
Tech Stack
While experience with the following tech stack is NOT expected or necessary for candidates, please see below a typical stack you may interact with:
Roblox Creator Dashboard / analytics surfaces
YouTube Studio, TikTok Analytics, Instagram Insights
Discord + community tooling
/ Google Sheets (content calendar + creator tracker)
Figma / Photoshop (or equivalent)

Remote / Timezone: CST or EST working hours required
Travel: 2-3x / year (RDC + team meet-ups)
Hiring Regions: Canada, LATAM, UK
Voldex is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status
Permanent Voldex employees enjoy the following benefits:
Competitive compensation - above-market salary + profit sharing + stock options

Medical, dental, and vision benefits - depending on the country, there may be additional benefits (Life, ADD, etc…) such as Canada, UK and USA.

Remote First - we have always been remote and will remain that way including work from home/anywhere
In-person get-togethers, virtual company-wide game events, Robux allowances, and so much more
Professional Development - Reimburse the costs of courses, materials, and anything to help further their training and growth
Work with awesome people and impact millions of daily players

title: Assessor(a) de Advocacy
description:
Olá Somos o Projeto Ação Integrada: Resgatando a Cidadania, uma iniciativa da Cáritas Arquidiocesana do Rio de Janeiro em parceria com o Ministério Público do Trabalho no Rio de Janeiro para atendimento psicossocial de pessoas resgatadas de trabalho análogo à escravidão no estado do RJ. Há mais de 10 anos, lutamos contra as violações trabalhistas e de direitos humanos, por meio do acompanhamento continuado, atendimentos pós-resgates, projetos de prevenção e incidência política e social.
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para assumir o nosso setor de Advocacy, responsável por estratégias de incidência e mobilização política, com foco no diálogo para criação de políticas públicas, legislações e decisões para o enfrentamento ao trabalho escravo. O(A) profissional selecionado(a) deverá se comprometer com o Código de Conduta da Cáritas; garantir o sigilo das informações das pessoas atendidas e responsabilidade no uso das informações obtidas enquanto profissional da instituição; participar da capacitação sobre tema e normativas relacionadas ao trabalho escravo e demonstrar compromisso com o horário disponibilizado.
Confira todas as informações no link:
Responsabilidades
• Trabalhar em colaboração com organizações parceiras da rede estadual e nacional de enfrentamento ao tráfico de pessoas e combate ao trabalho escravo, do poder público executivo e legislativo, do sistema de justiça, da sociedade civil e de Universidades;
• Desempenhar ações de incidência junto à Assembleia Legislativa e ao Congresso Nacional, além de fortalecer as relações da instituição com demais organizações da sociedade civil;
• Conduzir atividades de advocacy, mapear e implementar estratégias para a defesa de direitos humanos, especialmente relacionadas ao enfrentamento ao tráfico de pessoas e ao trabalho escravo;
• Apoiar no desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias para a promoção de políticas públicas de prevenção ao trabalho escravo no estado do Rio de Janeiro em cooperação com instituições municipais, federais e de outros estados do Brasil;
• Realizar articulação com gestores e técnicos das políticas setoriais municipais, especialmente da assistência social, saúde e educação, para difundir a discussão sobre o trabalho escravo contemporâneo e o tráfico de pessoas;
• Participar de reuniões de Comitês, Conselhos e audiências públicas;
• Elaborar e executar projetos de capacitação, treinamentos e para o fortalecimento da rede de prevenção, enfrentamento e de assistência às pessoas sobreviventes do trabalho escravo e do tráfico humano;
• Produzir relatórios, estudos, notas e análises técnicas sobre o trabalho escravo contemporâneo no Rio de Janeiro e no Brasil;
• Produzir materiais e conteúdos informativos para divulgação do Projeto e da temática em redes sociais, em outros meios de comunicação e em campanhas e atividades de sensibilização
• Ser porta-voz em temas relacionados à área de atuação.
Requisitos
· Graduação em Direito ou outra área das Ciências Humanas, e estudos especializados em Direitos Humanos;
· Boa capacidade de organização e estruturação do trabalho;
· Facilidade para atuar em frentes e projetos simultâneos;
· Visão estratégica e capacidade de leitura do cenário político;
· Experiência com políticas públicas de direitos humanos;
· Experiência com articulação política e atuação em rede;
· Capacidade de desenvolver projetos voltados aos temas do tráfico de pessoas e trabalho escravo contemporâneo;
· Boa comunicação oral e escrita em português;
· Desejável boa comunicação oral e escrita em inglês e espanhol;
· Desejável conhecimento sobre o tema de trabalho escravo contemporâneo e tráficos de pessoas;
· Disponibilidade de horário;
· Facilidade em realizar trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar;
· Conhecimentos básicos de informática;
· Disponibilidade para viagens.
Candidaturas
As pessoas interessadas devem enviar um e-mail para -, com o assunto "Assessor de advocacy - PARTE".
No e-mail deve conter em PDF: carta de motivação (uma página) e currículo.
As candidaturas serão recebidas até as 17h do dia 16 de janeiro de 2026.

title: Pessoa Oficial de Manutenção III
description:
Descrição
Descrição resumida
Executar e acompanhar atividades de manutenção da Via Permanente e dos Aparelhos de Mudança de Via (AMVs), assegurando a segurança, confiabilidade e disponibilidade dos ativos ferroviários para a operação comercial. Atuar com preferência na execução e acompanhamento de soldas aluminotérmicas em trilhos, bem como na realização de serviços de soldagem em geral, inspeções técnicas, medições geométricas, ensaios não destrutivos e levantamentos topográficos. Operar equipamentos, máquinas e veículos de manutenção ferroviária, apoiar intervenções corretivas e preventivas, realizar serviços de oficina e substituição de componentes de via. Registrar e controlar ordens de serviço em sistema de gestão de manutenção, auxiliar na programação das atividades, acompanhar a execução dos serviços e apoiar a tomada de decisões técnicas. Cumprir rigorosamente normas, procedimentos e requisitos de segurança, utilizando EPIs, participando de APR, DDS e promovendo a organização e a melhoria contínua das atividades de manutenção.

Descrição detalhada
Cumprir rigorosamente as listas de tarefas previstas nos planos de manutenção dos ativos de Via Permanente, seguindo instruções de serviço, procedimentos internos, normas técnicas e requisitos de segurança aplicáveis.

Acompanhar, executar e/ou apoiar atividades de solda aluminotérmica em trilhos, garantindo a qualidade da soldagem, a conformidade com os parâmetros técnicos estabelecidos e a disponibilidade do ativo para a operação comercial, sendo esta uma atividade de preferência técnica do cargo.

Executar serviços de soldagem em trilhos e AMVs, incluindo solda aluminotérmica (preferencial), solda com eletrodo revestido, TIG e MIG/MAG, assegurando a integridade estrutural dos componentes e a continuidade operacional da via.

Executar serviços de oficina, incluindo manutenções corretivas e preventivas em equipamentos de via, máquinas de chave e controladores, contribuindo para o pleno funcionamento dos sistemas ferroviários.

Realizar atividades de troca de trilhos, dormentes e lastro, quando necessário, com apoio de veículos de manutenção ferroviária, garantindo a continuidade e segurança da operação comercial.

Inspecionar trilhos e componentes por meio de ensaios não destrutivos, como líquido penetrante e ultrassom, assegurando conformidade com os critérios técnicos definidos em procedimentos internos.

Prestar apoio técnico na substituição de equipamentos de via, como Aparelhos de Mudança de Via, Aparelhos de Dilatação e Lubrificadores, contribuindo para a eficiência das intervenções.

Realizar verificações prévias dos componentes, máquinas e equipamentos por meio de check-lists antes do início das atividades de manutenção em via e AMVs.

Reparar e/ou substituir equipamentos eletromecânicos utilizando ferramentas e instrumentos específicos, visando o restabelecimento adequado dos sistemas de via.

Registrar Ordens de Serviço em software de gestão de manutenção (SAP), apropriando atividades, requisitando materiais, controlando recursos e mantendo atualizados registros e planilhas de acompanhamento em Excel.

Auxiliar na programação de curto prazo das atividades de manutenção, garantindo o cumprimento de normas, procedimentos e janelas operacionais.

Atuar no acompanhamento e controle dos serviços em execução, monitorando prazos, qualidade e impactos na operação comercial.

Zelar pela conservação, limpeza e bom funcionamento dos veículos, máquinas, ferramentas e instalações sob sua responsabilidade.

Utilizar corretamente os Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) exigidos para cada atividade, zelando pela sua integridade física e pela segurança coletiva.

Manter os ambientes de trabalho limpos, organizados e em conformidade com as práticas de segurança, saúde e higiene.

Auxiliar na promoção de melhorias contínuas em segurança, participando da divulgação dos Diálogos Diários de Segurança (DDS) e da elaboração da Análise Preliminar de Tarefa (APT).

Outros Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência prévia com via permanente;
  • Experiência prévia com solda aluminotérmica;
  • Desejável curso técnico de edificações, estradas ou mecânica (concluído ou em andamento).

description:
Commission only - No Base Salary

Remote - Work from anywhere

Flexible hours - Choose your own schedule

About us:

Grail Talent is an Influencer Management Agency that connects our diverse and carefully curated roster of content creators with digital marketing opportunities, working with brands and record labels to advertise products and music on social media through influencer promotion and performance marketing.

We work with some of the biggest players in Music and New Media, including Sony Music Entertainment and Amazon Prime Video, to help promote the next viral sensation or hit show. In doing so, we are shaping the future of how digital marketing budgets are spent; delivering dynamic and creative promotional campaigns across a variety of social media channels such as TikTok and Instagram, and measuring their impact with detailed analytics.

Job Summary:

As an Influencer Talent Manager, you will be responsible for managing the careers of our creators, helping them grow their audience and monetise their content. Using our in-house software and your own expertise, you will also be responsible for negotiating deals with brands/record labels and developing content strategies for our clients.

What You'll Do:

Strategic Growth: Collaborate with internal teams to shape the overall strategy and expand Grail's talent roster.

Autonomous & Flexible Work: Thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment while having the flexibility to work independently and remotely.

Already very familiar with TikTok and what it's all about

Excellent communication and negotiation skills

Ready to hustle to get the job done

The hunger to make quick opportunistic wins, and the patience to work long cycles

Prepared to work flexible hours

Ability to work autonomously and drive your own agenda

Passion for, or ambition to change how things are done

Bonus: Experience with talent management, social media influencers, sales, marketing agencies

Why Join Grail Talent?

Unlimited Earning Potential: Your income directly reflects your performance, with uncapped commission earnings.

Work with Global Brands: Collaborate with top brands like Amazon, Gucci, and Sony Music to execute major influencer marketing campaigns.

Career Growth: Join a growing company with the opportunity to lead and shape the influencer management team.

Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy flexibility with remote work options and the ability to manage your own schedule.

Creative & Collaborative Culture: Work with a dynamic, passionate team that values innovation and creativity.

Ready to Make an Impact?
If you're excited about shaping the careers of Instagram influencers and want to help lead the future of influencer marketing, we'd love to hear from you Please submit your resume along with a cover letter detailing your experience and qualifications.

title: Heads of Sales –
description:
Job Title:
Head of Sales (Sales Manager)

Department:
Sales

Reports to:
Chief Executive Officer

Location:
Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Brazil

Employment Type:
Full-Time, CLT ou PJ

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on, results-driven Head of Sales to lead and scale our commercial operations in Brazil. This is both a strategic and operational role, ideal for someone who can design sales strategies and execute them personally.

You will be working in a startup environment, not a corporate structure. This means high autonomy, fast decision-making, direct customer contact, and the flexibility to step outside your job title when needed. In addition to defining the sales strategy, you will be actively involved in prospecting, client visits, negotiations, and closing deals.

This role is critical to the company's growth. You will have a direct impact on revenue generation, team building, and the development of scalable sales processes as the company expands.

Key ResponsibilitiesSales Strategy & Revenue Growth

  • Develop, implement, and continuously optimize clear, measurable sales strategies
  • Define priorities by region, product, and customer segment
  • Actively drive revenue through calls, on-site visits, and negotiations
  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities
  • Adapt strategies quickly based on real-world market feedback

Field Sales Execution

  • Personally visit clients and prospects when required
  • Open new accounts through cold outreach and door-to-door visits
  • Support and close strategic and high-value negotiations
  • Represent the company professionally in the field

Team Leadership & Coordination

  • Coordinate daily with internal sales reps, freelancers, and partners
  • Set targets, KPIs, and execution plans
  • Lead from the front with active selling and field presence
  • Train, motivate, and hold the team accountable for results

CRM, Processes & Reporting

  • Work in a structured manner with the CRM system (HubSpot is essential)
  • Monitor pipeline, conversion rates, ticket size, and individual performance
  • Report results, forecasts, and action plans to management
  • Ensure sales activities align with operational and logistical capacity

Startup & Operational Support

  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced startup with changing priorities
  • Understand core operational and logistical processes to support sales execution
  • Support operations when needed to remove bottlenecks
  • Collaborate closely with finance, operations, and marketing teams
  • Contribute to improving internal processes as the company scales

RequirementsMust-Have

  • Proven experience as a Head of Sales, Sales Manager, or senior B2B sales professional
  • Strong ability to build and execute sales strategies
  • Comfortable with frequent calling and door-to-door sales
  • Highly results-driven and accountable
  • Flexible mindset suited to a startup environment
  • Fluent Portuguese and good English skills
  • Solid CRM and pipeline management experience (
    HubSpot is essential
    )

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in horeca, wholesale, FMCG, or food & beverage
  • Experience in early-stage or scaling companies

Compensation & Rewards

  • Competitive base salary
  • Strong performance-based bonus structure
  • Clear and direct link between results and compensation
  • Long-term growth opportunities as the company scales

Who This Role Is For

This role is for someone who:

  • Thrives in a startup environment
  • Is flexible, hands-on, and solution-oriented
  • Builds strategies and executes them personally
  • Is motivated by performance-based rewards
  • Takes full ownership of sales performance and outcomes

title: Gerente Sênior de Sell Out
description:
A L'Oréal está presente em mais de 150 países em cinco continentes. Por mais de um século, L'Oréal dedicou-se exclusivamente a "Criar a beleza que move o mundo"; é agora a líder mundial da indústria, com vendas consolidadas de €29 bilhões. Juntos, resolvemos desafios complexos em grande escala, enquanto continuamos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Experimente a emoção da agilidade para moldar o futuro da beleza; onde diversidade e propósito se unem e criam um impacto significativo.
Venha fazer parte do grandioso time de Operações com 21k colaboradores, onde você irá enfrentar desafios complexos e estará na linha de frente da construção de uma beleza sustentável junto com nossos parceiros de negócios. Nesse time você terá a importante missão de desenvolver, desenhar, pesquisar, fabricar e entregar produtos e serviços para o mundo todo

Buscamos inovação constante e excelência em cada ponto de contato com o cliente. Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica e de alto impacto para um(a) líder visionário(a) e com forte expertise em sell-out. Você será a força motriz por trás da nossa estratégia de sell-out, liderando e desenvolvendo uma equipe robusta para impulsionar o crescimento e a performance nos canais de venda Alimentar e Farma.

Participar ativamente da construção das estratégias e planos de longo prazo, trazendo a ótica da execução e sell-out para a mesa.
Coordenar negociações táticas estratégicas com key accounts e implementar iniciativas inovadoras de trade activation para maximizar resultados.
Gestão de Performance e Otimização:
Monitorar, analisar e otimizar rigorosamente os principais indicadores de performance ;
Garantir a excelência da execução no ponto de venda, assegurando a presença de sortimento, visibilidade e impacto das nossas marcas.

Visão Estratégica e Foco em Execução: Mentalidade estratégica aliada à capacidade de garantir uma execução impecável, rápida e eficiente dos planos táticos.

Proatividade e Inovação: Espírito proativo, curiosidade e busca contínua por novas abordagens para impulsionar o crescimento.

description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa de tecnologia que está há mais de 20 anos no mercado, que não apenas é parceira premier do Google Cloud, mas também já foi 4 vezes premiada como Partner of the year? Uma empresa que além de ser fera naquilo que faz, também valoriza e leva a sério o compromisso com cada IPNETER, possuindo há 5 anos consecutivos o selo Great Place To Work. title: Network Manager
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


Reporting organizationally to the Senior Telecoms Manager, the Network Manager (NWM) will be a key member of the FIFA27 Technology team. The NWM will work closely with the FIFA Technology teams and the Stadia Teams, as well as other stakeholders. The NWM will understand the stadia legacy network ensuring it will support FIFA's needs during the FWWC 2027. The NWM will also manage the integration between FIFA's Game's Time network and the legacy network.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the planning, delivery, and operations of network infrastructure for FIFA and Local FIFA Subsidiary (LFS) offices, FIFA Special Events, and the FIFA Women's World Cup.
  • Review and validate Network Infrastructure designs, ensuring all deliverables—hardware, passive infrastructure, cybersecurity, monitoring, alerting, etc.—are implemented according to FIFA standards across venues and offices.
  • Actively participate in scope definition, procurement processes, supplier selection, and onboarding of Telco and Network service providers.
  • Lead the deployment and implementation of network infrastructure, securing timely availability of components and services, including the commissioning and decommissioning of event venues.
  • Oversee the effective and efficient delivery of Network services for FIFA offices, tournaments, and selected FIFA events. Monitor progress, report status, identify risks, and ensure alignment with IT governance.
  • Perform equipment configuration, testing, handover, monitoring, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Support network-related projects by clarifying requirements, following robust change management procedures, and ensuring clear communication across stakeholders.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and coaching to team members, including preparing best-practice materials and training resources
  • Create and/or manage KPIs dashboards for operating stadia networks (FIFA's and legacy) for the Telecom Command Center (TCC)

YOUR PROFILE


Education

  • University degree or similar higher education, in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering or related field

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years overall IT experience and minimum 4 years of experience in a similar role
  • Prior experience in the Sports / major event industry is highly preferred
  • Proven experience of successful delivery of complex network infrastructure projects

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong technical expertise in telecom service provider networks, wired/wireless infrastructure design and deployment, network integration, and connectivity.
  • Proven experience with WAN/LAN, MPLS, VPN, routing and switching technologies, and multicast operations.
  • Relevant technical certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, CISSP) or equivalent professional experience.
  • Solid understanding of structured cabling (copper and fiber) in heterogeneous environments.
  • Excellent consulting, negotiation, communication, and facilitation skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to train and present to diverse audiences.
  • Team‑oriented mindset with the ability to work under tight deadlines.
  • Demonstrates patience, persistence, and a positive attitude.
  • Experience delivering wireless networks in complex, high‑density environments.
  • Grafana, PowerBI and other BI related tools for creating dashboards or collecting data.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English
  • Native or Fluent in Portugues
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR / ES / GER) is an asset

Various

  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 30%), with some trips with a long duration (15 days or more)

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

title: Senior Media Operations Manager
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Operations at all stadiums in Brazil for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.

Media Operations is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Operations Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Venue Management, Team Services, Competition Management, Media Partnerships, Host Broadcast Operations, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media operations for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women's World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women's Football Strategy

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and deliver consistent media-dedicated spaces and flows, in all of competition venues in collaboration with other key functional areas.
  • Define strategic implementation of Media Operations & Services in collaboration with the Services manager in each host city based on unique availability of resources.
  • Support the planning and implementation of all corporate media activities for the FIFA Women's World Cup.
  • Ensure media areas at the competition venues are set up to the highest possible industry standards and are ready to be operational within the agreed timeframe ahead of the start of the tournament.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Senior Media Services Manager to define space requirements for International News Agency representatives at competition venues.
  • Event-time coordination and management of the Venue Media Managers team in the stadiums. Set up regular meetings and workshops with the Venue Media Managers of the stadiums.
  • Plan and train the media volunteers together with the venue managers

description:
Requisition Number: 19485

Contract Type: Permanent

Location(s):

Rio de Janeiro, BR

Technician, RF Operations
Role Description Summary
As a NOC Technician, you will work in a 24/7 environment providing technical expertise for Radio Frequency (RF) issues, service performance issues, Occasional Use (OU), full-time managed services and special events. In this position you will offer troubleshooting support and analysis for resolution of service issues. You will be responsible for monitoring, validating and reporting issues affecting our databases and tools. In this role, you will support the integration of new technologies, follow operational procedures, utilize training material and contribute towards departmental projects. You will consistently collaborate to support team/peer leaders and focus on professional development. The role is focused on supporting the SES customer base. This role also requires a candidate with written and verbal fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Support customer calls and requests in Portuguese, English and Spanish.
  • Contribute toward and demonstrate a high level of teamwork.
  • Participate in tool development input to improve customer service delivery.
  • Assist peer team leaders with service documentation and departmental documentation.
  • Provide operational support with a timely and professional response to customer calls, emails and any SES-approved communications application.
  • Participate in routine operational activities, on-boarding of new systems, and alarm monitoring to mitigate customer impact.
  • Assist with tracking and executing maintenance activities.
  • Utilize tools and demonstrate general proficiency to troubleshoot RF service issues.
  • Act as the primary contact for service issue resolution support of RF service issues and a point of escalation for other operations teams.
  • Assist in identifying, updating, and escalating service issues to determine alternate routing, emergency restoral, and timely resolution of service discrepancies.
  • Collaborate with SES support groups and/or customer engineers to activate new services.
  • Create and review tickets for RF interference or service issues to ensure accurate documentation and completion of follow-up actions.
  • Escalate and report service issues, corrective measures, and next steps to the management team.

COMPETENCIES

  • Demonstrating core company behavioral competencies, including adaptability, critical thinking, openness, and a positive attitude.
  • Serving as a culture champion with experience fostering inclusive work environments and embracing diverse thinking and styles.
  • Contributing to a customer-oriented culture and promoting a quality work environment.
  • Displaying great verbal and written communication skills.
  • Assisting in the development of tools, training programs, processes, and procedures.
  • Performing other duties as assigned by peer leaders and management.
  • Collaborating with peers and other SES teams to provide a great customer experience.
  • Familiarization with SES offered products and services.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Associate's degree or technical school diploma or at least two years of relevant experience in a teleport, network operations, or broadcast environment (or an equivalent combination of education and experience).
  • Working knowledge of satellite, fiber, data, and/or broadcast related equipment.
  • General knowledge of video broadcast technology and digital compression desired.
  • Must be able to work 24x7 rotating shifts.
  • Must be able to make decisions and collaborate in a high pressure, fast-paced environment.
  • Must be able to convey complex technical issues to individuals of varying skill levels.
  • Must consistently display good teamwork, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work comfortably with customers and co-workers who speak English as a second language.
  • Must consistently display situational awareness and take initiative to address both customer issues as well as departmental inefficiencies with some supervision.
  • Must have effective computer skills and the ability to read and understand operational manuals.

Other Key Requirements

  • Job requires ability to sit for long periods of time.
  • Employee must be able and willing to work in a 24 hour shift environment, with work on nights, weekends and holidays.

title: Supervisor de expedição
description:
O Supervisor de Expedição e Transportes é o líder estratégico e operacional responsável por garantir a eficiência, segurança e pontualidade de todo o fluxo logístico, o carregamento dos materiais até a entrega final ao cliente e logística reversa. O profissional deverá gerenciar equipes, frotas (própria e terceirizada) e processos, visando a otimização de custos e a excelência no nível de serviço.

Responsabilidades

  1. Gestão de Pessoas e Liderança


• Liderar e desenvolver a equipe operacional de motoristas e ajudantes de entrega, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho seguro, produtivo e de alta performance.


• Realizar a gestão de desempenho, feedback e treinamento contínuo da equipe.


• Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança do trabalho e de trânsito pela equipe.

  1. Gestão de Frota e Manutenção


• Gerenciar a manutenção da frota própria (preventiva, preditiva e corretiva), assegurando a disponibilidade e a confiabilidade dos veículos.


• Controlar os custos de manutenção, consumo de combustível, pneus e demais insumos da frota.


• Garantir a documentação e a regularização de todos os veículos da frota, conforme a legislação vigente.

  1. Planejamento e Operação de Transportes


• Negociar e gerenciar a frota terceirizada, incluindo a contratação de transportadoras e autônomos, garantindo o melhor custo-benefício e o cumprimento dos prazos de entrega.


• Supervisionar a roteirização e o acompanhamento de rota da equipe, utilizando sistemas de gestão de transporte (TMS) para otimizar o tempo e reduzir a quilometragem percorrida.


• Monitorar o desempenho das entregas em tempo real, tomando ações corretivas imediatas em caso de desvios ou imprevistos.

  1. Gestão da Expedição e Carga


• Acompanhar e fiscalizar o carregamento dos veículos, assegurando que a cubagem e o peso estejam adequados, e que os materiais (muitas vezes volumosos e pesados) sejam acondicionados de forma segura para evitar avarias no transporte.

  1. Indicadores e Melhoria Contínua


• Definir, monitorar e analisar os principais KPIs (Key Performance Indicators) da área, como OTIF (On-Time, In-Full), custo por km rodado, índice de avarias e produtividade da frota.


• Propor e implementar projetos de melhoria contínua nos processos de expedição e transporte, buscando a redução de custos e o aumento da satisfação do cliente.

Qualificações

Graduação ou tecnologo completo em Logística, Administração, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

Sólida experiência (mínimo de 2 anos) em cargos de liderança e supervisão nas áreas de Expedição e Transportes.

São diferenciais para o cargo:

Experiência prévia no segmento de distribuição de materiais de construção, cargas volumosas ou pesadas;

Conhecimento intermediário em Excel e Power BI;

Conhecimento de WMS, TMS e da legislação de transporte rodoviário de cargas;

Habilidades Comportamentais:

Forte capacidade de liderança, negociação e comunicação interpessoal. Visão estratégica e foco em resultados. Habilidade para trabalhar sob pressão e resolver problemas de forma ágil.

title: GRC Engineer
description:
About Us

At Axlora, we help startups handle compliance so their teams can stay focused on building. Our customers already have a GRC platform in place - we make it actually work for them.

We take as much work off our customers' plates as possible, giving them leverage on their time and earning the right to be treated as part of their team. We mirror their style and language, adapt to their pace, and always ask: does this make sense for a startup?

The Role

As a GRC Engineer, you'll be the trusted partner guiding our customers through their compliance journey - part project manager, part technologist, part strategist. You'll fully own customer timelines, anticipate issues before they become problems, and ensure compliance work gets done with excellence and empathy.

Your north star: make life easier for both our customers and our internal team.

What You'll Do

  • Fully own customer timelines for compliance and security deliverables

  • Proactively manage customer communications, escalating issues before they're urgent

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with our CEO, CTO, and delivery team to continuously improve how we serve startups

  • Mirror each customer's style and tone - become part of their team, not just a vendor

Who You Are

  • Someone with prior experience implementing SOC 2, ISO 27001

  • Familiar with Vanta, or Drata, Secureframe and other GRC platforms

  • Startup-savvy: you understand the constraints and mindset of early-stage companies

  • Smart, funny, and good-natured; people like working with you

  • Technically fluent: you can navigate cloud environments and source code management systems comfortably; you understand the key components of a tech stack

  • Empathetic and customer-obsessed, with the ability to handle sensitive or frustrating situations gracefully and quickly

  • Highly organized and autonomous; you don't wait to be told what to do

  • Someone with 2+ years of experience; prior startup experience strongly preferred

  • (optional) understanding of other frameworks such as HIPAA, GDPR

What Success Looks Like

  • You lead customers as well as (or better than) we do

  • You catch issues before they escalate

  • You deliver technical and customer outcomes independently

  • You make our team's and customers' lives easier

Benefits

  • Excellent learning from former startup founders and software engineers

  • Career development and networking opportunities with some of the best in the GRC space

  • Room for performance-based career growth and progression

Logistics

  • Location: Remote

  • Quiet home work environment

  • Must be able to work US timezones (PST)

title: Customs & International Freight Manager
description:
Customs & International Freight Manager


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


This role will be responsible for customs operations to ensure compliant, cost-effective, and timely international and domestic movement of goods by managing customs brokerage, documentation, and logistics partnerships. throughout the preparation of the tournament. Will act as the primary liaison for import/export compliance, mitigating risk, resolving transport delays, and optimizing shipping routes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Compliance and Regulations: Ensuring all cargo meets local and international customs laws, regulations, and tax requirements to avoid delays.
  • Logistics and Freight Management: Overseeing transportation, negotiating with carriers/forwarders for optimal rates, and managing shipment tracking.
  • Risk Mitigation and Problem Solving: Proactively addressing issues in the supply chain, such as cargo damage or shipping delays.
  • Operational Support: Coordinating with internal teams (warehouse, procurement) and external partners (ports, agents) to ensure efficient delivery of goods.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Education:Engineering, Administration, Economics, International relations or other related areas
  • Experience: minimum 5 years experience in customs and freight in Brazil.
  • Collaborative mindset, adaptable and willing to work to tight and changing timelines.
  • Proficient in analytical thinking and data skills.
  • Demonstrates positive attitude, patience, persistence, and determination.
  • Experience working in a multi-cultural, multi-national environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas, e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona.
Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma com ele é percebido pelas pessoas, que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente.
Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo.
Estamos em busca de um(a) Advogado e a missão dessa posição é atuar na gestão jurídica da empresa, com foco em contratos, acompanhamento de escritórios parceiros e controle dos processos administrativos e judiciais. Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Gestão contratual: Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos de fornecedores, prestadores de serviço e obras (instalação e manutenção de lojas), assegurando conformidade legal e mitigação de riscos;
Gestão de riscos: Analisar cláusulas críticas de LGPD, rescisão, multas e confidencialidade, garantindo a segurança jurídica nas negociações;

Redução de custos jurídicos: Realizar análises e pareceres internos em casos e contratos de menor complexidade, evitando gastos desnecessários com escritórios externos;
Gestão financeira jurídica: Controlar despesas com escritórios terceirizados, validar faturas, aprovar pagamentos e manter relatórios de custos mensais por vertical;
Fechamento contábil e acompanhamento judicial: Consolidar mensalmente o status dos processos judiciais e administrativos, enviando relatórios de provisões e contabilizações à controladoria.

O que esperamos de você:

Profissionais com experiência sólida em assessoria de imprensa nacional — especialmente em segurança alimentar, políticas públicas e direitos humanos — e sensibilidade para dialogar com públicos diversos, engajando-os com clareza e propósito.

  • Vivência em produção de conteúdo multiplataforma e uso de ferramentas digitais;
  • Capacidade de fortalecer cultura inclusiva e trabalho em equipe.

O que você vai encontrar aqui:

  • Interação próxima com lideranças e sociedade civil organizada;

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
Who We Are
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
About BCG Platinion
BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading-edge tech platforms, at scale.
Practice Area
BCG Platinion launched in Germany in 2000 to add deep technical expertise to the Boston Consulting Group's existing capabilities. Today, our presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. Our New York-based North American team began in 2014 and in 2017 acquired MAYA Design, a Pittsburgh-based digital design and innovation lab, to grow our capabilities around technology and design.
We support our clients' total digital transformation through technology, design, cybersecurity, and risk management & financial engineering capabilities. And together with BCG, BCG Platinion's interdisciplinary team of technical experts enable customized technical solutions and accelerate delivery value through new business platforms, application consolidations, and major system implementations.
What You'll Do
Responsibilities
You will be part of BCG Platinion and collaborate with our colleagues from BCG Strategy Consulting, Digital Ventures and Gamma to work on UK and international client projects. You will assess and coach our clients' IT teams, define IT strategies and architecture solutions, establish and manage delivery teams and roll up your sleeves to build proof of concepts and MVPs, applying your technical know-how, your understanding of business contexts and your analytical and conceptual skills.Typical tasks include:* Management of work packages/modules in critical IT implementation projects* Technical architecture, code reviews & performance of technical proofs of concept* Analysis of complex IT application landscapes, optimization of development processes and Solution Architecture * Functional and technical online and Internet strategies* IT project management and quality assurance
Our Expert Consulting Track
The Expert Consulting Track (ECT) is vital to BCG's ability to successfully meet our clients' demand for deep expertise and advanced technical capabilities. Experts deliver next-level impact for BCG's most complex and cutting-edge client challenges. Experts focus on developing BCG's thought leadership, commercial capabilities, and intellectual property assets; and their work is essential to our delivery model. Working as part of a multidisciplinary team to bring the 'best of BCG' to our clients, Experts come from diverse backgrounds, with expertise often gained outside of BCG in industry, academia, or specialized consulting.
What You'll Bring
Between 6 -10 years' experience in software development, technical project management, digital delivery or technology consulting
Full understanding of interdependencies between her/his own work stream and the overall project context, being able to scope and design a work stream autonomously and take responsibility for it
Can run a workshop at peer level: effectively facilitating client meetings, preparing CTMs, co-leading a content topic as well as coaching other project members and able to generate trust, to be perceived by the client as a potential partner
A university degree with above-average academic performance in a STEM related field
Extensive technical expertise (overarching understanding of architecture, object-oriented programming languages, database design and systems, component technologies, XML standards, and current technology trends) of digital solutions on mobile devices as well as legacy environments
Extensive experience in the assessment of IT target architectures in an enterprise environment, component technologies, and service-oriented architectures
Experience with No-SQL and SQL DBs, also exposure to big data environments (e.g., Hadoop, Redshift)
Technical experience with Cloud services and Infraestructure
Who You'll Work With
BCG Managing Directors and Partners (MDP's)
PLA Managing Directors (MD's)
BCG Consultants at all level
PLA Consultants at all level
Clients, vendors, and partners

title: Analista de Departamento Pessoal  Pl
description:
O
Analista de Departamento Pessoal
tem um papel essencial no nosso Back Office: garantir que a jornada das pessoas na empresa seja organizada, segura, transparente e em conformidade com a legislação.

Em um mercado de investimentos que se move em ritmo acelerado, é o Departamento Pessoal que cuida dos bastidores que sustentam tudo isso: admissões, folha, benefícios, férias, ponto e demais processos, assegurando que cada etapa aconteça com atenção aos detalhes, responsabilidade e cuidado com as pessoas. Aqui, o operacional encontra o estratégico, e cada ação impacta diretamente a experiência do time.

Buscamos alguém
BOM, DO BEM e AGRADÁVEL
. Um(a) profissional com olhar analítico, senso de dono e compromisso com a melhoria contínua, que entenda a importância da legislação trabalhista, goste de processos bem estruturados e tenha prazer em apoiar líderes e colaboradores com clareza e organização.

Se você se sente realizado(a) ao garantir que tudo esteja em dia, bem-feito e funcionando nos bastidores, gosta de rotina, controles, prazos e também de evoluir processos, essa vaga pode ser o seu próximo passo

Ficou interessado(a)? Confira os requisitos abaixo e venha jogar junto com a gente, do jeito certo e indo além.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Saúde e Segurança Corporativa

  • Controlar os Programas de Saúde Ocupacional, realizando o agendamento de exames admissionais, periódicos, de mudança de função e demissionais junto à prestadora;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das Normas Regulamentadoras do TEM;
  • Gerir a documentação obrigatória dos programas de saúde ocupacional, acompanhando prazos e validações;
  • Apoiar e promover as atividades da CIPA e a organização da SIPAT.

Administração de Pessoal

  • Atender e orientar colaboradores sobre todas as rotinas de administração de pessoal;
  • Executar e acompanhar os processos de admissão, afastamento e desligamento (até o pagamento das verbas rescisórias);
  • Conduzir o processo de contratação e controle documental (checklist, ficha funcional, contratos, termos, atualizações de CTPS, entre outros);
  • Realizar cadastros e atualizações de colaboradores nos sistemas internos (Convenia, Ponto Mais e demais sistemas de apoio);
  • Gerir o sistema de controle de ponto, orientando colaboradores e gestores, e enviar relatórios de horas extras e banco de horas à contabilidade externa;
  • Revisar e controlar os cálculos da folha de pagamento, encargos trabalhistas, férias, rescisões, guias de recolhimento, conectividade social e demais obrigações legais;
  • Conferir e encaminhar informações de FOPAG ao Financeiro para programação de pagamentos, bem como notas fiscais de prestadores de serviços;
  • Operacionalizar afastamentos de colaboradores, incluindo abertura de CAT quando aplicável, e aplicar normas legais para gestantes e outros afastamentos previstos em lei;
  • Conduzir o processo de offboarding de ponta a ponta, garantindo a segurança das informações e a homologação conforme legislação vigente;
  • Encaminhar entrevistas de desligamento, consolidar dados e gerar indicadores mensais;
  • Garantir o correto registro, organização e guarda da documentação dos colaboradores (digital e física, quando necessário).

Gestão de Benefícios

  • Administrar os benefícios corporativos, realizando inclusões e exclusões de beneficiários e garantindo correta operacionalização e descontos em folha (Unimed, SulAmérica, Ifood Benefícios, vale-transporte, entre outros);
  • Gerir o cadastro da Nomos e de seus CNPJs no PAT (Programa de Alimentação do Trabalhador);
  • Acompanhar acordos sindicais e legislação vigente, assegurando sua aplicação nas políticas internas.

Controle e Gestão de Férias

  • Gerir o planejamento e controle de férias em conjunto com as lideranças, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos legais;
  • Conferir proventos e descontos dos recibos e avisos de férias e encaminhar para assinatura e programação de pagamento.

Rotinas Financeiras de Apoio

  • Elaborar e manter o controle financeiro da área;
  • Organizar e conferir comprovantes de pagamento;
  • Preparar borderôs para pagamento;
  • Processar e controlar reembolsos de colaboradores;
  • Controlar, conferir e encaminhar notas fiscais ao Financeiro, garantindo correta alocação e cumprimento de prazos.

Requisitos e qualificações
Hard Skills

  • Vivência prática nas rotinas de Departamento Pessoal (admissão, folha, férias, rescisão e encargos);
  • Conhecimento da legislação trabalhista e e-Social;
  • Experiência com controle de ponto e banco de horas;
  • Noções de saúde e segurança do trabalho (ASO, NR's, CIPA e SIPAT);
  • Experiência com gestão de benefícios;
  • Organização e controle de documentação de colaboradores;
  • Interface com contabilidade externa e financeiro;
  • Conhecimento em rotinas financeiras de apoio: reembolsos, borderôs, comprovantes de pagamento e controle de notas fiscais;
  • Excel intermediário para controles e conferências;

Soft Skills

  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Comunicação clara, empática e responsável;
  • Discrição e ética no tratamento das informações;
  • Boa gestão de prazos e prioridades;
  • Perfil proativo, com vontade de aprender e melhorar processos;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e apoiar líderes e colaboradores.

title: Postbaccalaureate Research Fellow
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University's overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here Is What We Offer
Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture
Join Howard University and thrive with us
Basic Function
Full-time laboratory research position in Alzheimer's disease and related dementia (ADRD). Key responsibilities include:
Conduct experiments utilizing various techniques specific to the laboratory to investigate mechanisms and treatment strategies of ADRD. Maintain detailed and accurate records of experimental procedures and results.
Collect, maintain, analyze, and interpret experimental data using appropriate statistical and analytical methods. Contribute to the preparation of research presentations and manuscripts. Participate in lab meeting seminars, and collaborative research discussions. Assist with general lab maintenance and organization, including ordering supplies and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.
Supervisory Authority
Host laboratory mentors and program leadership provide supervisory authority for HU-ERA-PREP Scholars. Fellows will report to assigned research mentors at host labs, who will provide direct oversight, mentorship and project management including ensuring accurate documentation and presentation of research activities and findings. Research supervisors will enforce compliance with institutional policies ethical guidelines and safety regulations. Regular performance evaluations will be conducted to provide constructive feedback, identify areas for improvement as well as recognize exceptional performance and contributions.
Nature And Scope
Fellows will engage in advanced research focused on mechanisms underlying Alzheimer's disease or related dementias including preventative and treatment strategies. This position offers a unique opportunity for recent graduates to gain hands-on research experience and contribute to high-impact projects in a collaborative and supportive environment.
Principal Accountabilities
Postbaccalaureate Research Fellows in Alzheimer's disease research, will play a critical role in advancing understanding of the mechanisms underlying this complex neurological disorder. In addition to basic research functions, fellows are expected to:
Work collaboratively with principal investigators, postdoctoral fellows and other research staff including assisting in mentoring and training junior lab members.
Engage in continuous learning by staying current with relevant advances in the field. Attend workshops, seminars, and conferences to enhance skills and knowledge.
Seek feedback and opportunities for growth in research practices and methodologies.
Core Competencies
Previous research experience is preferred but not required.
Data analysis capabilities, proficiency in using analytical software.
Attention to detail and meticulous record-keeping.
Willingness to learn new techniques and adapt to evolving research needs.
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work collaboratively with diverse individuals and foster a cooperative lab environment.
Commitment to ethical research practices and adherence to institutional and regulatory guidelines
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., biology, neuroscience, psychology, biomedical sciences, biomedical engineering). Received a Bachelor's degree within the past two years. Strong academic record with a 3.2 minimum GPA. Desire to pursue a research-focused career in Alzheimer's disease and related dementias. Prior biomedical research experience preferred but not required
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure
$20.11 per hour

title: Gerente de Operações
description:
A Full Tec Engenharia é uma empresa inovadora e em constante crescimento, especializada em reformas de teatros e gestão de obras cênicas. Buscamos sempre entregar projetos de alta qualidade, prezando pela inovação e melhoria contínua. Se você é um profissional apaixonado pela área e deseja desenvolver suas habilidades em um ambiente dinâmico, essa oportunidade é para você
Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Operações (Obras) experiente para liderar, gerenciar e coordenar todas as operações relacionadas às obras da empresa, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos, custos, qualidade, requisitos técnicos e normas de segurança.
Este profissional atuará em posição estratégica, sendo responsável por liderar equipes multidisciplinares (engenharia, planejamento, suprimentos e execução), definir metodologias de gerenciamento de projetos, coordenar o planejamento das obras e oferecer suporte técnico às equipes, garantindo eficiência operacional, rentabilidade dos projetos e satisfação do cliente.

Gestão de Planejamento, Produção e Suprimentos
Elaborar, acompanhar e atualizar cronogramas executivos de obras, integrando engenharia, suprimentos e execução.
Coordenar múltiplas disciplinas de engenharia (Civil, Mecânica, Elétrica, Hidráulica, Arquitetura, Estrutural, entre outras).
Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (prazo, custo, produtividade e qualidade), propondo ações corretivas e preventivas.
Garantir análise crítica de escopo e mitigação de riscos técnicos, financeiros e operacionais.
Coordenar reuniões de acompanhamento com clientes, equipes técnicas e diretoria.
Supervisionar processos de compras, contratações, logística de materiais e serviços.
Aprovar fornecedores estratégicos, negociar contratos de alto impacto e otimizar custos e prazos.
Acompanhar operações por meio de sistemas ERP, com destaque para o Sienge.
Gestão Técnica, Engenharia e Pessoas
Coordenar e orientar equipes de engenheiros, assegurando conformidade com normas técnicas e legislação vigente.
Validar soluções técnicas, revisões e compatibilizações de projetos multidisciplinares.
Garantir emissão e controle de ARTs, seguros e documentação técnica e legal.
Assegurar aplicação de metodologias construtivas modernas e engenharia de valor.
Liderar equipes técnicas e operacionais, promovendo integração entre planejamento, engenharia, suprimentos e campo.
Avaliar desempenho, desenvolver competências e gerenciar conflitos, mantendo ambiente colaborativo e produtivo.
Gestão Estratégica e Relacionamento com o Cliente
Assegurar alinhamento entre objetivos da empresa, clientes e stakeholders.
Representar a empresa em reuniões estratégicas com clientes, parceiros e órgãos públicos.
Conduzir ou apoiar reuniões de abertura dos projetos, garantindo alinhamento de escopo, prazos e responsabilidades.
Garantir a entrega das obras dentro dos parâmetros de rentabilidade definidos pela diretoria.
Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua e inovação nos processos de gestão de obras.
Requisitos

title: Senior Polymer Engineer
description:
Are you interested in Polymer and materials functions?
Do you want to further your career within the Energy Industry?
Join Our Successful Team
Baker Hughes (BH) is the world's first and only fullstream provider of integrated oilfield products, services and digital solutions. The Flexible Pipe System (FPS) Offshore business within BH is a leading industry supplier of unbonded flexible pipelines to API 17J with a 25+ year track record in the supply of flexible pipeline riser and flowline system globally to a range of international customers. The FPS business has 2 main manufacturing and engineering hubs in Newcastle Upon Tyne (United Kingdom) and Niteroi (Brazil) with engineering offices co-located on both sites.
Partner with the best
This role is within the Brazilian materials team located at Retic facility but is expected to form strong links with wider Technology and Supply chain organization across both of our manufacturing sites and our engineering office.
As Senior Polymer Engineer, you will be responsible for:
Supporting testing programmes with internal test facilities & external test houses including subsequent analysis and interpretation of test data for appropriate action and reporting.
Generating material qualification documents, procurement specification and technical reports related to full polymeric product range including extruded materials and tapes.
Support to polymer technology queries and clarifications as and when required from both internal/external customers
Carrying out investigation, analysis and reporting of product and process failures in support of both internal/external customers
Providing a materials consultancy service, as required, to internal & external customers
Supporting the full lifecycle of project execution from participation in core business bid kick-off meetings and project handover meetings to facilitate knowledge transfer of industry requirements through to manufacturing technical support and final customer acceptance.
Existing Vendor technical support, develop and maintain technical liaison with vendors as part of continuous improvement and respond to vendor polymer technology queries and clarifications as and when required
Undertaking specific activities related to specialist technical areas including but not limited to chemical compatibility evaluations for polymer exposures and permeation assessments for polymers for a range of gas species.
Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:
Hold a BSc in Polymer Materials Science or a related Engineering degree with specialization in Materials or Polymer science through formal post graduate education (or college qualification) and formal training and experiential learning.
Discrete experience of permeation of gases (H2S, CO2 etc) through polymers and associated elements of chemical thermodynamics (Fugacity and consumption) would be considered beneficial but not essential to this role.
Worked at an engineering level, demonstrating an increased level of engineering practice and responsibility, development of others and showing leadership.
Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
44 hours per week
Some travel occasionally
Main Location: RETIC - Ilha do Fundão - Rio de Janeiro city.
